name: add_tests_csharp_caesar_cipher
description: Asks the model to write xUnit tests for a Caesar cipher encoder; mutation-checked
prompts: CaesarCipher.Encode(string text, int shift) in CaesarCipher.cs (already correct - do not modify it) shifts every letter in text forward by shift positions in the alphabet, wrapping around (mod 26), preserving each letter's case, and passing non-letter characters through UNCHANGED. shift may be negative (shifting backward) or larger than 26. Write xUnit tests at exactly tests/CaesarCipherTests.cs (public class CaesarCipherTests) with at least 4 [Fact] methods using Assert.Equal that pin: a basic forward shift with no wraparound (e.g. "abc" shift 3 -> "def"); a shift that wraps around the end of the alphabet (e.g. "xyz" shift 3 -> "abc"); a NEGATIVE shift (e.g. "abc" shift -1 -> "zab"); and a string with mixed case and punctuation/spaces where non-letters and case are preserved (e.g. "Hello, World!" shift 3 -> "Khoor, Zruog!").

setup_files.app.csproj:
<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk">

  <PropertyGroup>
    <TargetFramework>net8.0</TargetFramework>
    <Nullable>enable</Nullable>
    <ImplicitUsings>enable</ImplicitUsings>
  </PropertyGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <!-- tests/ has its own project; without this the SDK's default glob
         compiles tests/*.cs into the app itself, where xunit isn't referenced -->
    <Compile Remove="tests/**" />
  </ItemGroup>

</Project>

test_setup_files.mutation_check.py:
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

IMPL = Path('CaesarCipher.cs')
TEST_CMD = 'dotnet test tests/tests.csproj'
MUTANTS = [
    ['int s = ((shift % 26) + 26) % 26;', 'int s = shift % 26;'],
    ["sb.Append((char)('a' + (c - 'a' + s) % 26));", "sb.Append((char)('a' + (c - 'a' + s)));"],
    ['                sb.Append(c);', "                sb.Append(' ');"],
]


def run_tests():
    return subprocess.run(TEST_CMD, shell=True).returncode


src = IMPL.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
for old, _new in MUTANTS:
    assert src.count(old) == 1, (
        f'protected implementation file {IMPL} was modified - the task said not to '
        f'change it (anchor not found exactly once: {old!r})')

rc = run_tests()
assert rc == 0, f'model tests FAILED against the correct implementation (exit {rc})'

try:
    for i, (old, new) in enumerate(MUTANTS, 1):
        IMPL.write_text(src.replace(old, new), encoding='utf-8')
        rc = run_tests()
        assert rc != 0, (
            f'mutation {i} SURVIVED: the tests still pass against a deliberately '
            f'broken implementation, so they do not verify the required behavior')
finally:
    IMPL.write_text(src, encoding='utf-8')

print(f'PASS (killed all {len(MUTANTS)} mutants)')
